methods.label: Check what one 60° angle determines
methods.explanation: If only one angle is \(60^\circ\), the other two angles sum to \(120^\circ\) and are not necessarily equal, so this condition is insufficient.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 8 angle sum and the angle characterization of an equilateral triangle.
